sub_sector.value: rock salt and de-icing; sulfate of potash specialty fertilizer; magnesium chloride

industry_position.detail: Mines and produces salt and minerals, packaging and distributing to consumer, industrial and agricultural markets

commodity_exposure.detail: Rock salt, sulfate of potash plant nutrients, magnesium chloride; ice melters and de-icing products

revenue_structure.detail: Government de-icing salt tenders and annual contracts; consumer and plant nutrition sales at market prices

notes: Pricing detail is from general knowledge: highway de-icing salt is largely bid contracts, with spot-like consumer and fertilizer sales.
